summary: BlackRock Private Investments Fund filed an 8-K reporting preliminary results of its issuer tender offer for up to 5% of outstanding common shares, which expired August 31, 2026. Approximately 175,858 shares, or about 0.51% of shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026, were validly tendered and not withdrawn. The purchase price per share will be based on net asset value per share as of September 30, 2026, with final results to follow. The tender was substantially undersubscribed, a typical feature of closed-end interval fund repurchase offers; no board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for final NAV pricing and any future repurchase program announcements.
